lessons.title: Graph modeling & construction
lessons.description: Combine entity relationships with semantic retrieval.
lessons.conceptOverview: Property graphs represent nodes and edges with attributes; RDF represents triples. Ontologies define types and relationships. Extraction proposes entities and links, while entity resolution merges references to the same thing. Keep evidence and confidence on extracted claims rather than treating generated relationships as facts.

lessons.title: Graph querying & hybrid search
lessons.description: Combine entity relationships with semantic retrieval.
lessons.conceptOverview: Graph databases such as Neo4j support relationship traversal, often through Cypher. Traversal answers explicit structural questions; embeddings retrieve similar concepts. A hybrid pipeline can use vector candidates to find entry nodes, then traverse a bounded neighborhood. Limit depth and fanout to control cost and noise.

lessons.title: GraphRAG & evaluation
lessons.description: Combine entity relationships with semantic retrieval.
lessons.conceptOverview: GraphRAG can retrieve connected evidence or summarize communities to answer broader corpus questions. Community detection groups densely connected nodes, but summaries can lose minority details. Evaluate multi-hop answers, provenance, extraction quality and index-update cost against a simpler RAG baseline.
